{"args":["-lc","cat > /tmp/bench.sh <<'EOF'
set -e
declare -A dirs=( [Debug]=build_debug [Release]=build_release [RelWithDebInfo]=build_relwithdebinfo [MinSizeRel]=build_minsizerel )
declare -A sizes
declare -A means
for bt in Debug Release RelWithDebInfo MinSizeRel; do
  d="${dirs[$bt]}"
  sizes[$bt]=$(stat -c %s /app/$d/program)
  sum=0
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    t=$(/app/$d/program)
    sum=$((sum + t))
  done
  means[$bt]=$(awk "BEGIN {printf \"%.3f\", $sum/5}")
  echo "$bt size=${sizes[$bt]} sum=$sum mean=${means[$bt]}"
done
# find largest/smallest sizes
largest_bt=""; largest_sz=0; smallest_bt=""; smallest_sz=0
for bt in Debug Release RelWithDebInfo MinSizeRel; do
  s=${sizes[$bt]}
  if [ -z "$largest_bt" ] || [ "$s" -gt "$largest_sz" ]; then largest_bt=$bt; largest_sz=$s; fi
  if [ -z "$smallest_bt" ] || [ "$s" -lt "$smallest_sz" ]; then smallest_bt=$bt; smallest_sz=$s; fi
done
size_pct=$(awk "BEGIN {printf \"%.2f\", ($largest_sz-$smallest_sz)*100/$largest_sz}")
echo "SIZE smallest=$smallest_bt($smallest_sz) largest=$largest_bt($largest_sz) pct=$size_pct"
# fastest/slowest by mean
fastest_bt=""; fastest_t=""; slowest_bt=""; slowest_t=""
for bt in Debug Release RelWithDebInfo MinSizeRel; do
  m=${means[$bt]}
  if [ -z "$fastest_bt" ] || awk "BEGIN{exit !($m < $fastest_t)}"; then fastest_bt=$bt; fastest_t=$m; fi
  if [ -z "$slowest_bt" ] || awk "BEGIN{exit !($m > $slowest_t)}"; then slowest_bt=$bt; slowest_t=$m; fi
done
speed_pct=$(awk "BEGIN {printf \"%.2f\", ($slowest_t-$fastest_t)*100/$slowest_t}")
echo "PERF fastest=$fastest_bt($fastest_t) slowest=$slowest_bt($slowest_t) pct=$speed_pct"
# write markdown (alphabetical: Debug, MinSizeRel, Release, RelWithDebInfo)
{
echo "# Build Comparison Results"
echo ""
echo "| Build Type | Binary Size (bytes) | Execution Time (ms) |"
echo "|---|---|---|"
for bt in Debug MinSizeRel Release RelWithDebInfo; do
  echo "| $bt | ${sizes[$bt]} | ${means[$bt]} |"
done
echo ""
echo ""
echo "## Size Analysis"
echo "The smallest binary is $smallest_bt (${smallest_sz} bytes), which is ${size_pct}% smaller than the largest binary $largest_bt (${largest_sz} bytes)."
echo ""
echo "## Performance Analysis"
echo "The fastest build is $fastest_bt (${fastest_t} ms), which is ${speed_pct}% faster than the slowest build $slowest_bt (${slowest_t} ms)."
} > /app/results.md
cat /app/results.md
EOF
bash /tmp/bench.sh"],"command":"bash","timeout_ms":120000}
